origin: ground centre of footprint at y=0 (unless noted in node_notes)

steps: optimize --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --flatten false --join false --instance false --simplify false --palette false --prune false

toneMapped_false_rule: ^(brand_|trailer_side|trailer_rear|mark53)|led|light_|beacon  (brand colours, livery decals, LEDs/beacons: set material.toneMapped=false so Walmart blue #0071CE / yellow #FFC220 render exact)
anchors_convention: Empty nodes; +Z forward. anchor_seat = operator hip (H-point) on the seat top; anchor_stand = operator feet on the platform floor; anchor_tiller_grip = hand point on the handle. Parent the operator (e.g. worker.glb) to the anchor.

no_anchor.amr: autonomous mobile robot, no operator position

material_merge.rule: per animatable node (pivot Empty), all static sub-meshes merged by material: opaque untextured colours -> one clay_palette material (base-colour + metallic-roughness palette PNG/WebP, per-face UVs collapsed to texel centres, NEAREST sampling: do not change the sampler/filters); livery decals + brand solids + lamps -> one brand_atlas material (decal atlas + emissive-mask atlas, emissiveStrength = brightest lamp). Transparent materials kept separate. Result: 1-2 draws per animatable node.

r160_data_uri.page: src/qa/datauri_check_r160.html (single self-contained page, every GLB inlined as data:model/gltf-binary;base64, three@0.160.0 from unpkg)

rig.drawbar: cartN_drawbar hinges at the front axle clevis - rotate about local X to raise / lower (rest = horizontal, eye at hitch height 0.33 m)

node_notes.tractor: origin on the ground directly under the kingpin/fifth wheel (= rear tandem centre); drive node

node_notes.landing_gear: child of trailer; inner legs + sand pads; origin on the ground between the pads; translate +Y to raise
node_notes.steer_FL/steer_FR: children of tractor; Empty on the steering kingpin axis (x=+-0.90, at axle height 0.52 m), rotate about local Y to steer
node_notes.wheel_FL/FR: children of steer_FL/FR; origin exactly at the hub/axle centre, spin about local X
node_notes.wheel_RL1/RR1/RL2/RR2: tractor rear dual wheels, children of tractor, origin at axle centre, spin about local X
node_notes.trailer_wheel_L1/R1/L2/R2: trailer dual wheels, children of trailer, spin about local X
node_notes.trailer_door_L/R: children of trailer, origin on the outer hinge line at door bottom: rotate about Y to swing open (L: negative angle opens outward, R: positive)

rig.skinning: every vertex weighted 1.0 to one bone (rigid toy segments) -> cheap, no candy-wrapping
rig.Walk: 1.0 s loop (31 frames @30fps), in place; drive root at ~1.35 m/s (stride 0.67 m, 2 steps/cycle) to avoid foot slide
rig.Idle: 2.0 s loop (61 frames @30fps): breathing, head look, arm sway
